_no.shitsherlock_: Isidor Shitsherlock came up the line with his mother's thimble and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Isidor Shitsherlock shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Isidor Shitsherlock borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Teodor Punchworth was badly wounded. Isidor Shitsherlock reached up to fix a sandbag at R-R17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Viktor "Crow" Daone of the Concord (@daone101). Grey Mill has been won. Isidor Shitsherlock listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet struck Isidor Shitsherlock below the ribs at R-R17. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Anselm "Saint" Davis of the Concord (@lucas_davis1775). Isidor Shitsherlock looked over the parapet at R-R17 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Anselm "Saint" Davis of the Concord (@lucas_davis1775).
The House of Shitsherlock sent Arno Shitsherlock after Isidor Shitsherlock. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Arno Shitsherlock tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Arno Shitsherlock (Hegemony) and Edmund Swag (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at the Bone Quarry for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Arno Shitsherlock raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam of the Concord (@pineapplejamming).
The medics cleaned Arno Shitsherlock's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-R17.
Arno Shitsherlock wrote a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams's mother, because Shadow could not find the words. Shadow signed it.
Arno and Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams tried to teach the squad a song in two languages. The squad learned the wrong half of each.
alex_rose_dir: By the time Zeno "Saint" Dir reached N-F17, the war was 14 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Zeno "Saint" Dir aimed just below it. Quentin "Button" Jaze was badly wounded.
Zeno "Saint" Dir has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely, gravely wounded.

Zeno "Saint" Dir was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Lucien Joseph was badly wounded. The whole squad at N-F17 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Zeno "Saint" Dir's bullet that found Cyril "Ash" Aws, gravely wounded.
Zeno counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Silas Jarkusrodan was grazed.
anxiousgourd: Dietrich "Mole" Anxiousgourd arrived on Day 15 as a replacement. The men in V-F4 had been fighting for 15 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Dietrich "Mole" Anxiousgourd only heard boots on the duckboards at V-F4, then nothing but pain. Raider: Casimir Lilly of the Concord (@_bell_lilly_). There was no bed for Dietrich "Mole" Anxiousgourd. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns.
No bed for Dietrich "Mole" Anxiousgourd yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
For days Dietrich was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
ben._.rocco: Bastian "Saint" Rocco arrived at S-F15 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.

Bastian "Saint" Rocco hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. Verdel Ridge has been won. Bastian "Saint" Rocco listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Bastian "Saint" Rocco sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Bastian "Saint" Rocco only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last.

Wiring party. Bastian "Saint" Rocco held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F15, and everyone came back. A letter from home found Bastian "Saint" Rocco before the night shift. Bastian "Saint" Rocco folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is lost. Bastian "Saint" Rocco heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Bastian "Saint" Rocco was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Bastian "Saint" Rocco tried to remember the price of a loaf in Coldwater. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

Bastian "Saint" Rocco reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta of the Hegemony (@slightlyretarded69). A letter from home found Bastian "Saint" Rocco before the night shift. Bastian "Saint" Rocco folded it small and kept it close.

A single shot from across the wire hit Bastian "Saint" Rocco in the thigh at S-F15. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Felix Serreno of the Hegemony (@anabelen.serreno). The bearers reached Bastian "Saint" Rocco at S-F15 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Felix Serreno of the Hegemony (@anabelen.serreno).

Another member of the House of Rocco reached the line: Quentin Rocco. He asked where Bastian "Saint" Rocco had slept, then chose a different corner. Quentin Rocco left the work of a rifleman to become a chaplain. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

The Hegemony sentry, Emil Potato, shouted once. Quentin Rocco silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@boiled_potato31) Quentin Rocco was on the dawn watch at S-F15 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Quentin Rocco was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin of the Hegemony (@demirkeskin06). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F15. Quentin Rocco has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home found Quentin Rocco before the night shift. Quentin Rocco folded it small and kept it close.

Quentin Rocco took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-F15, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Otto Aegisdirecti of the Hegemony (@aegisdirectivee). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin Rocco answered to number 110. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Quentin Rocco wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Quentin Rocco never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. A letter from home found Quentin Rocco before the night shift. Quentin Rocco folded it small and kept it close.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Quentin Rocco has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Quentin Rocco was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F15. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Ivo Maupat of the Hegemony (@maupat_03).
For days Quentin Rocco was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F15. Quentin Rocco was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Walter Mat of the Hegemony (@civo_mat).
The House of Rocco sent Nils Rocco after Quentin Rocco. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A man asked Nils Rocco to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Nils was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
crun_chypotatoes: Casimir Chypotatoes reached Q-F1 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F1. Casimir Chypotatoes has learned to walk bent double.

The telephone wire to Q-F1 was cut by shelling four times. Casimir Chypotatoes crawled out and spliced it four times. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Chypotatoes. Casimir Chypotatoes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Casimir Chypotatoes looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The line to the battery keeps going dead at the same spot near the Sunken Road. Casimir Chypotatoes suspects it is not the shelling. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Chypotatoes. Casimir Chypotatoes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A parcel from home held a comb. Casimir Chypotatoes has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead and Casimir Chypotatoes divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

Casimir Chypotatoes took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at Q-F1, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Casimir Therealstycx of the Hegemony (@therealstycxz). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Casimir Chypotatoes fell at Q-F1 and never moved again. Shot by Casimir Therealstycx of the Hegemony (@therealstycxz).

Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes joined Q-F1 under the shadow of Casimir Chypotatoes's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes left the work of a sapper to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

The Hegemony sentry, Felix Panzerfaust, shouted once. Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@panzerfaust5803) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes free. A letter came for Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes pinned it to the dugout wall.
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
Isidor opened his eyes today and asked for water. At Q-F1 they cheered when the news came up the line.
dayum_the_pencil: Hugo Pencil stepped off the supply cart at U-F11 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

A letter reached Hugo Pencil from Halden. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached U-F11 with the rations. Hugo Pencil ate while listening to the revised orders.
Hugo Pencil began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Fog so thick that Hugo Pencil could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
Word of Hugo Pencil's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Hugo Pencil fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Henrik Chrisgghill was badly wounded. Hugo Pencil ate breakfast without a word.
Hugo Pencil smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Bastian Nouniquetag came out for a cup and was grazed.

A round came through the loophole Hugo Pencil was watching at U-F11 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Hugo Pencil fell at U-F11 and never moved again. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss).
Another member of the House of Pencil reached the line: Jakub "Hollow" Pencil. He asked where Hugo Pencil had slept, then chose a different corner.
Jakub wound a spool of wire across a shelled road at night. By morning the line was working, and the road was not.
emfrulla: Dietrich Emfrulla found a place in S-R11 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak. The transfer made Dietrich Emfrulla a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Dietrich Emfrulla wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Dietrich Emfrulla used it. Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog was badly wounded. Dietrich Emfrulla walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home reached Dietrich Emfrulla before dusk. Dietrich Emfrulla read it twice and slept a little easier.

Face blackened with soot, Dietrich Emfrulla spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Gustav Squared was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Dietrich Emfrulla before dusk. Dietrich Emfrulla read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Dietrich Emfrulla helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Jonas Little, badly wounded. Dietrich Emfrulla cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A letter from home reached Dietrich Emfrulla before dusk. Dietrich Emfrulla read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich Emfrulla fixed the strap on Norbert Duran's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home reached Dietrich Emfrulla before dusk. Dietrich Emfrulla read it twice and slept a little easier.

At S-R11 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Dietrich Emfrulla won the bet. Emil Zgz was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Dietrich Emfrulla before dusk. Dietrich Emfrulla read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony and Ivo "Mud" Samwade of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Bone Quarry all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

Dietrich Emfrulla and Gustav Dillonl share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Dietrich Emfrulla anyway.

Dietrich Emfrulla fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Hugo "Bones" Squared was badly wounded. Dietrich Emfrulla got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.

Dietrich waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Yann Zgz did, and was gravely wounded. Dietrich became a stretcher bearer today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
forever_dm_jay: Jakub Jay left a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain behind in Greyhallow and came up the line with a cracked shaving mirror. The men noticed at once that he hates silence more than shelling. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Jakub Jay folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Jakub Jay was hit in the hip at P-F16. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Ivo Ursarte of the Concord (@not_ursarte).
The bearers moved Jakub Jay's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
The medics would not give up on Jakub Jay. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to P-F16 today.
Jakub Jay (Hegemony) and Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Lantern Hill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

The Concord raiders came over at P-F16 in the middle of the night. Jakub Jay met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Benedikt Theoneonlyfi of the Concord (@theoneonlyfishboy).
Tobias Jay arrived carrying the family name of Jakub Jay. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Karel "Doc" One fell asleep on watch. Tobias Jay took over without waking Doc, and told the sergeant nothing.
Tobias began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
giulsscam: Teodor Giulsscam arrived on Day 12 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Teodor Giulsscam has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
Lucien "Hollow" Luhring kept watch so that Teodor Giulsscam could sleep. Then Teodor kept watch so that Hollow could. Neither slept.
Teodor Giulsscam saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Casimir "Ghost" Tine, was grazed.

Teodor Giulsscam came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Back from the raid, Teodor Giulsscam found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Hello' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
Teodor Giulsscam was put on light duty at N-F12: peeling potatoes, sorting mail, and complaining.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Teodor is whole again, or near enough for the line.
glorified_toaster: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram Toaster arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Bram Toaster had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Wendel Bartdrent, grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Bram Toaster during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Toaster. Bram Toaster read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bram Toaster spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Toaster. Bram Toaster read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bram Toaster answered to number 790. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Bram Toaster helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
At the Brickworks, Bram Toaster of the Hegemony and Roland Bryce of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Bram Toaster spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Machine-gun fire swept R-C5. Bram Toaster took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Toaster. Bram Toaster read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bram Toaster lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Toaster. Bram Toaster read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Bram Toaster healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Bram Toaster offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Across from R-C5, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram saw it. Zeno "Hollow" Batman was badly wounded.
hocu.sporkus: In Millbank, Clement "Mud" Sporkus was a blacksmith. In N-F20, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a blacksmith again.
Clement "Mud" Sporkus drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Clement "Mud" Sporkus tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.

Clement "Mud" Sporkus and Pavel Vinsaint tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Clement "Mud" Sporkus before the night shift. Clement "Mud" Sporkus folded it small and kept it close.

Clement "Mud" Sporkus got a letter from Anna. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. The letter for Clement "Mud" Sporkus smelled faintly of soap. Clement "Mud" Sporkus held it close for a long time before opening it.

Clement "Mud" Sporkus was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at N-F20. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Silas Stoll of the Hegemony (@easton.stoll). Clement "Mud" Sporkus was killed outright at N-F20, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Silas Stoll of the Hegemony (@easton.stoll).
Roland Sporkus had heard about Clement "Mud" Sporkus's courage. At N-F20, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Ivo Ursarte found a blister on Roland Sporkus's heel and bound it with a strip of Ivo own shirt. Roland Sporkus did not argue. Roland got a letter from an old teacher, with a note about spelling. Roland laughed, and fixed two words in the reply.
itzwill16: Dorian Itzwill stepped off the supply cart at Q-F14 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Dorian Itzwill fired, and Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu was grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dorian Itzwill wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Dorian Itzwill fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Ulrich Felix was grazed. Grey Mill is lost. Dorian Itzwill heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Dorian Itzwill was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Henrik "Brick" Sunley of the Hegemony (@alex_sunley).
Dorian Itzwill asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Wendel Itzwill put a rosary of rough beads beside the bunk. Someone who had known Dorian Itzwill helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A man asked Wendel Itzwill to describe Stoneyford without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Wendel Itzwill and Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
A round went through the rim of Wendel Itzwill's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Anselm "Doc" Juliofck of the Hegemony (@juliofck).
Wendel Itzwill's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F14 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Two flares went up over the Bone Quarry. Wendel counted the seconds between them and the sound. It was a habit by now.
jcadenfarris: They issued Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his mother's thimble in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli and Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Across the wire at the Bone Quarry, Casimir Chickenman of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris raised his head for a heartbeat too long at P-F21. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Casimir Eclark of the Hegemony (@eclark43).
Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
An officer asked who was writing the menus. Bastian admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home.
lm994663: Day 8. The corporal put Rafael Lm beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Rafael Lm carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Rafael Lm could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Rafael Lm (Hegemony) watched Emil Sully (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Sorrow Copse, and held fire until both were gone. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael Lm is number 561 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The stretcher bearers took Rafael Lm in on a busy morning in S-S15. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second. Victory at Grey Mill. Rafael Lm let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Rafael Lm received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Mail came up the line with a letter for Rafael Lm. Rafael Lm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Rafael Lm found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Rafael Lm splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
Rafael Lm's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Rain all night. Rafael Lm bailed water out of S-S15 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
A round went through the rim of Rafael Lm's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Grizzlychick of the Concord (@grizzlychicken1).

A round came through the loophole Rafael was watching at S-S15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Ulrich Kjwthe of the Concord (@kjwthe1). At last Rafael has a bed. The field hospital smells of soap and smoke, and he slept better than in weeks.
mannnylopes: Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes left a grandmother who prays for both armies behind in Oakmere and came up the line with a frozen apple. The men noticed at once that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-R6 changed before the cheering ended. Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes shouldered another load.
A loose thread in Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes won before reaching the end of his entry.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Edmund "Hollow" Biwott stood up to sing louder, and Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes fired. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott was grazed. The singing stopped.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes fired, and Gideon Wolves was badly wounded.
Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Rafael Caden was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Anselm saved Viktor Thervvival's last cigarette from a falling sandbag. Viktor Thervvival did not say thanks, but kept the stub.
rylan_45h: In Wyvern Cross, Ivo "Bones" Rylan was a bookbinder. In R-F8, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a bookbinder again.
Orders assigned Ivo "Bones" Rylan to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Ivo "Bones" Rylan added a leak above the man's head in pencil. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Ivo "Bones" Rylan looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Ivo "Bones" Rylan pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ivo "Bones" Rylan read a theatre review while peeling supper.

A bullet clipped Ivo "Bones" Rylan's helmet at R-F8 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Yann Spring of the Concord (@spring_7398). The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at R-F8 changed before the cheering ended. Ivo "Bones" Rylan shouldered another load.
Fever took hold of Ivo "Bones" Rylan overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.

Ivo "Bones" Rylan never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Bones" Rylan. Ivo "Bones" Rylan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Ivo "Bones" Rylan shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Casimir "Button" Batman, was grazed. The men at R-F8 heard Ivo "Bones" Rylan call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02). Ivo "Bones" Rylan finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Ivo "Bones" Rylan ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Bones" Rylan. Ivo "Bones" Rylan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ivo "Bones" Rylan watched a fly cross the ceiling of the ward for an hour. It was the most exciting thing that happened, and he was glad of it.

The medics called Ivo "Bones" Rylan 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Ivo "Bones" Rylan is back on the line. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Ivo "Bones" Rylan folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. Ivo "Bones" Rylan reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Ivo "Bones" Rylan fired once through the steel loophole at R-F8 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Matthias Mart was badly wounded. Two shots, one miss. The second found Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas, grazed. Ivo "Bones" Rylan cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Bones" Rylan. Ivo "Bones" Rylan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ivo "Bones" Rylan answered to number 138. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Ivo "Bones" Rylan did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Ivo "Bones" Rylan saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas, was badly wounded. Ivo "Bones" Rylan smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Wendel Superfeisty came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
Ivo "Bones" Rylan cut Casimir Shi's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

Ivo "Bones" Rylan remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Bones" Rylan. Ivo "Bones" Rylan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ivo "Bones" Rylan's hands still remember being a bookbinder's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.

The flare went up just as Ivo "Bones" Rylan reached the Concord parapet. Ivo "Bones" Rylan jumped down first. Marek Spencerbonth was the man waiting there, and Marek Spencerbonth fell. (@spencerbonthoux) Ivo "Bones" Rylan went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Florian Wman was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@bradb0wman) Ivo "Bones" Rylan was on the dawn watch at R-F8 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Ivo "Bones" Rylan was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Dietrich Samhatespeac of the Concord (@samhatespeace). A letter reached Ivo "Bones" Rylan in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

Ivo "Bones" Rylan rejoined the squad at R-F8. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. Ivo "Bones" Rylan kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

Ivo fired at a movement across the wire at R-F8. The man went down: Wendel Goober, grazed. Ivo raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter "Bones" Miked of the Concord (@miked8903).
samuelh.green2008: The draft reached T-F10 on Day 9. Gideon Green was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F10, Gideon Green listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A parcel came for Gideon Green that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Green wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Nils Goodnametake kept Gideon Green awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Nils could have walked there blind.
Gideon Green smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Bram Grotesque came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
The parcel's address was smudged. Gideon Green took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Nils Goodnametake and Gideon Green compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Gideon Green aimed just below it. Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel was badly wounded.
Gideon Green fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Bram "Mole" Kong was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Gideon caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.
scottkurom1: By the time Wendel Scottkurom reached T-F5, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Scottkurom kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Gideon "Rabbit" Deer and Wendel Scottkurom split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. After the loss of Grey Mill, Wendel Scottkurom helped stack spare sandbags at T-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Wendel Scottkurom wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Wendel Scottkurom made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.

Wendel Scottkurom was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins of the Hegemony (@hogggogins).
Wendel Scottkurom is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

A bullet hit Wendel Scottkurom in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at T-F5. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Neumann of the Hegemony (@schutze.neumann_). A single shot at T-F5. Wendel Scottkurom sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Neumann of the Hegemony (@schutze.neumann_).
Florian "Saint" Scottkurom arrived carrying the family name of Wendel Scottkurom. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Florian "Saint" Scottkurom lent Gideon "Rabbit" Deer a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Florian ran out of clean bandages at noon and boiled the old ones in a mess tin. They were whiter than before.
sterlinglance_: The old hands of S-C9 have been here since Day 1. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home found Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc before the night shift. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc folded it small and kept it close.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-C9 and grazed Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Tobias "Crow" Cowboii of the Concord (@the_cowboii). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc answered to number 758. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

The medics cleaned Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-C9. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc became a rifleman today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. A letter from home found Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc before the night shift. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc folded it small and kept it close.

Fresh from training, Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Clement Broccoli, grazed. A letter from home found Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc before the night shift. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc folded it small and kept it close.
Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Albin "Parson" Williambecke crossed it, Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc fired. Albin "Parson" Williambecke was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The sergeant at S-C9 called out a range and a spot. Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc was the only one who hit it. Benedikt Emmettofthek was gravely wounded.
A second spoon disappeared. Clement searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
sumtingwong7218: Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong and Otto Boi made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 971. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong and Hugo Jameson spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
A recruit asked Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong taught Jakub Thefunkmuffi to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Across from S-C14, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong saw it. Leopold Ker was grazed. A bullet went through Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong's upper arm at S-C14 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Bram Nathangrundm of the Concord (@nathangrundmeier).
Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
A letter came with Henrik Sumtingwong: "I am Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
The corporal found out Henrik used to be a postman. Henrik has been doing two jobs ever since.
tylermontygrisco: At the depot, Isidor Tylermontygr had practised answering to his name. At S-R4, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A bullet went into Isidor Tylermontygr's chest just under the heart at S-R4. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe of the Hegemony (@castlecrasher1). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Isidor Tylermontygr fell at S-R4 and never moved again. Shot by Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe of the Hegemony (@castlecrasher1).
Another member of the House of Tylermontygr reached the line: Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr. He asked where Isidor Tylermontygr had slept, then chose a different corner.

Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr is number 940. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Across from S-R4, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr saw it. Jakub Relations was grazed.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Brickworks every night, fed by Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr on one side and Nils Noraajs on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.

A sniper's bullet hit Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr at S-R4. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Edmund Seanlively of the Hegemony (@seanlively95). Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr was killed on watch at S-R4. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Edmund Seanlively of the Hegemony (@seanlively95).
Marek Tylermontygr asked about Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr on arriving at S-R4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Marek Tylermontygr found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank.

Marek was shot through the shoulder at S-R4. He kept hold of the rifle until the bearers pried it loose. Shot by Ulrich Tym of the Hegemony (@ty_m1015). A single shot at S-R4. Marek sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up.
The papers say Oskar "Button" Tylermontygr. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Marek Tylermontygr's eyes. Nobody in S-R4 argues.
v01py: Bastian "Lucky" Vpy took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bastian "Lucky" Vpy answered the first call, number 18 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Someone asked Bastian "Lucky" Vpy to wake them in ten minutes. He spent all ten worrying about how to measure them.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy held the mirror while Felix Topekeno shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Felix Kagr lent Bastian "Lucky" Vpy a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Felix Kagr and Bastian "Lucky" Vpy divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wiring party. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-F12, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Bastian "Lucky" Vpy was invited to the Officers' Mess. From today a gold star hangs over the trench where Bastian "Lucky" Vpy stands.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy and Felix Topekeno split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F12. Isidor Serrano was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

The shelling stopped while Bastian "Lucky" Vpy was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy was on the dawn watch at R-F12 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Bastian "Lucky" Vpy was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Emil "Lucky" Macwigger of the Hegemony (@macwigger2214). The flare went up just as Bastian "Lucky" Vpy reached the Hegemony parapet. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy jumped down first. Gideon Allistofeari was the man waiting there, and Gideon Allistofeari fell. (@allistofearisgod) After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bastian "Lucky" Vpy helped stack spare sandbags at R-F12. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy walked back up the communication trench to R-F12, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A border collie wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Bastian "Lucky" Vpy. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy gave it a name: Peg.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy had just lit a cigarette at R-F12 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche of the Hegemony (@elliott_goyhenetche).

Back on the fire step at R-F12. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy made Peg a little coat from an old sandbag. The dog looks ridiculous and knows it. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.
Bastian "Lucky" Vpy saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy gave Peg a bath in a shell hole. The dog came out muddier than before and very happy.

At R-F12 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy turned around and took a shovel blow. Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud). The raid was over in minutes. On the way back a machine gun swept no man's land, and Bastian "Lucky" Vpy did not reach the parapet. Killed in the night raid by Isidor Serrano of the Hegemony (@ana_serrano_7).

Zeno Vpy took the same post at R-F12 where Bastian "Lucky" Vpy stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Peg did not eat for two days after Bastian "Lucky" Vpy fell. On the third day it walked up to Zeno Vpy and sat down. That was that.
Zeno Vpy borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

A bullet hit Zeno in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F12. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Leopold Kapitancray of the Hegemony (@kapitancray). The bearers reached Zeno at R-F12 too late. One shot, and it was over.

Another member of the House of Vpy reached the line: Karel Vpy. He asked where Zeno Vpy had slept, then chose a different corner. Nobody had the heart to send Peg away. The border collie now follows Karel, the same way it followed Zeno Vpy.
xen0meter: Yann Meter joined the replacements on Day 13. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Yann Meter crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at N-F9 holds again.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Yann Meter waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

Yann Meter went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Karel Dustinviper was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@dustinviper11) Yann Meter jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Albin Gabor. The Concord medics will be busy. (@daniel.gabor.77964) Yann Meter made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Yann Meter crawled the last yards.
The medic looked at Yann Meter's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to N-F9. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Yann fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Severin Foolio, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
